contexts.text: Profanations of the Word make as it were a callosity... which absorbs the goods and truths of remains.
With those called Noah, persuasions did not obstruct and absorb the Lord's operation through remains.
Black in spiritual things is man's own voluntary, or evil, which absorbs and extinguishes the rays of light. AC 2492.
The sphere of one who regards himself in everything, appropriates to itself, and, as is there said, absorbs everything that favours it, thus [it absorbs] all the delight of the Spirits around him...
And they swallowed up the seven fat ears. To swallow up = to exterminate.
Thus is the light of truth absorbed and suffocated in darkness, as the light of the sun is in what is black.
Such are like objects which do not send back, but absorb the rays of light.
The earth swallowed them = damnation and Hell.
The memory with such appears darksome, being of such a nature as to absorb the rays of light and turn them into darkness.
Such things conduce to absorb malignities...
They are then swallowed up and fall down into Hell among their like.
In this world their bodies absorb and hide these things.
Used in the sense of swallowed up. TCR 642.
Absorbs and suffocates the rays of light...
A black colour is such that it absorbs all the rays... In like manner evil absorbs all the rays of intellectual light.
